answer.reason: The verses tell of Elath being built and restored to Judah, then recovered by Syria, which goes beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was built and restored to Judah by Azariah after Amaziah died
clauses.quote: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah

clauses.english: was recovered by Rezin king of Syria, who drove the Jews out
clauses.quote: Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath

doubts: DEU 2:8 only names Elath as a stage of Israel's journey, so it was left out.
2KI 14:22 names Azariah only in the surrounding verse; 2CH 26:2 gives Uzziah, the same king.
2CH 8:17 only says Solomon went there, so it was left out.
